"retro 2.5d racing game in formula cars with speed differences between cars giving a hierarchy of the 8 to 12 teams each having 2 drivers (1 being the player) each NPC driver has different stats so for example a fast driver could be on a mid, slow or a fast team. and a slow driver could be on a fast, slow, or mid team. you must display this as like a rating system so have different attributes to different drivers so out of 100 for defense, overtaking, qualifying, wet racing etc etc. and similar things for the cars itself. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
